NEW CAR STATS! TIME TRIAL LEADERBOARDS RESET!

Experience ROBLOX Racing like never before! Compete against other racers in qualifying and race sessions around unique circuits! Become a top driver, and unlock new helmets and cars in the process!

OTHER GAME MODES:
- Time Trial Mode with Leaderboards
- Unranked Mode where you can race without your Skill Rating being affected
